name: The Deer Lodge
bio: The Deer Lodge is a historic restaurant and tavern on Maricopa Highway in Ojai, serving smokehouse barbecue and pub food. It hosts an open mic every Wednesday and live music on weekends.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from deerlodgeojai.com and @ojaideerlodge.
source: public web search, the venue's website and public Instagram, and US Census address lookup, 2026-10-29
